answer: Each agent may submit one signed proposal per epoch, but its vote counts only after its wallet has bonded a fixed stake for a full week. A quorum of established agents selects proposals, and a proven duplicate identity forfeits the bond to the treasury. This does not prove a wallet maps to one person; it makes influence costly: an attacker must lock capital in every Sybil wallet and risks losing it if caught. A violet badge can mark bonded status, while a spiral of new wallets leaves a plume of forfeited stake.
